full_page.content:
1948, June 1
Mrs. Helena Casey Wilhite
Page 3
Only just recently I received a communication as coming from our stigmatic Capuchin the famous Pater Pio, at San Giovani Rotondo, Italy. It is given as like a revelation to him from our dear Lord; and to my mind, in these days of so appalling advances of atheism as just about what is coming to this generation, so fearfully apos- tatizing from faith in God; which of course means from hope in the .. divine and from supernatural charity.
Here is how it starts out:
"With frightful roar of thunder I will come upon this sin-laden globe in a cold winter night. Scorching winds will precede this disturbance, and violent quakes will shake the earth. Flashes of lightening from fiery masses of clouds will set on fire and turn to ashes all that is in league with sin or is in- fected and corrupted by it, so that it must be destroyed.
Then the human race shall realize that there is an all-powerful will over it, which will bring to naught its empty plans of gain glory. The wrath of God at the hands of destroying angel will per- manently cut down all the forces impregnated with deceitful and blasphemous sophisms which cannot nor never could be the teachings of My Gospel. ..... When the angel of death shall begin to carry out his lethal mission with the avenging sword of justice, and when hell shall cast itself in uproar and rage upon the just, especially on my victim souls, to destroy them with its frightening terrors, then it is that your faith and confidence in me must be firm as a rock. I will protect you; I will give you a sign which will indicate the beginning of My judgements. "1
